fire.domain: Light, conquest, the forge — the burning that creates and commands

earth.domain: Harvest, covenant, the hunt — the ground that sustains and binds

water.domain: The sea, ecstasy, desire — the depths that move and drown

air.domain: Authority, wisdom, messages — the mind that commands and connects

fire.name: Ace of Fire
fire.title: Prometheus
fire.upright: The fire is stolen. Prometheus reaches into the heavens and brings back something that was not meant for mortals. The Ace of Fire is the divine spark — the idea that costs everything to bring down. Create. But know the price.
fire.reversed: The gift rejected. Fire that burns the giver. The spark that was stolen and then wasted. Was the sacrifice worth it?
fire.prompt: Prometheus God of Stolen Fire as Divination Card

fire.name: Two of Fire
fire.title: Castor & Pollux
fire.upright: Two flames burn as one — but one is mortal, one divine. Castor and Pollux swore an oath to share immortality. The Two of Fire is the partnership that transcends difference. One of you will carry the other.
fire.reversed: The twin who resents. The pact broken. The immortal who tires of sharing death. Who is carrying whom?
fire.prompt: Castor and Pollux the Divine Twins as Divination Card

fire.name: Three of Fire
fire.title: Peitho
fire.upright: The room leans in. Peitho, goddess of persuasion, speaks and the world bends toward her words. The Three of Fire is the pitch — the moment when language becomes force. Speak. They are listening.
fire.reversed: The hollow pitch. Persuasion without substance. Charm that fades when the room empties. What are you actually selling?
fire.prompt: Peitho Goddess of Persuasion as Divination Card

fire.name: Four of Fire
fire.title: Icarus
fire.upright: The wax melts. Icarus plummets. The Four of Fire is the burnout — the moment ambition exceeds capacity, when the sun you flew toward becomes the thing that brings you down. The fall is not failure. It is proof you flew.
fire.reversed: The near-miss. Recovery from the crash. The lesson learned without the death. Fly again — but lower this time.
fire.prompt: Icarus Falling from the Sun as Divination Card

fire.name: Five of Fire
fire.title: Thersites
fire.upright: Thersites spoke back to kings. The ugliest soldier in the Greek camp, and the only one who told the truth about power. The Five of Fire is the voice of dissent — petty, unpolished, but not always wrong. Who is criticizing you, and why?
fire.reversed: The critic silenced — or the criticism that was pure poison. The hater who had no truth, only bile. Ignore them.
fire.prompt: Thersites the Ugly Truth-Teller as Divination Card

fire.name: Six of Fire
fire.title: Pheme
fire.upright: The word spreads. Pheme, goddess of rumor, amplifies your name until it belongs to everyone but you. The Six of Fire is the viral moment — intoxicating, uncontrollable, and already fading. Ride it. Don't believe it.
fire.reversed: The rumor that destroys. Fame that becomes infamy. The name you can't take back. What did you say that Pheme now owns?
fire.prompt: Pheme Goddess of Fame and Rumor as Divination Card

fire.name: Seven of Fire
fire.title: Talos
fire.upright: Talos patrols the shores of Crete — a bronze giant, inhuman, unstoppable, doing what it was built to do. The Seven of Fire is the algorithm. The system that shapes you without your consent. It is not evil. It is not good. It is programmed. Learn the code.
fire.reversed: The automaton broken. The system hacked. Talos felled by a single pin pulled from his heel. Even bronze giants have weaknesses.
fire.prompt: Talos the Bronze Automaton as Divination Card

fire.name: Eight of Fire
fire.title: Sisyphus
fire.upright: The boulder rolls. Sisyphus pushes. The Eight of Fire is the hustle — the ceaseless grind that defines the modern condition. But Camus said we must imagine Sisyphus happy. The push IS the purpose.
fire.reversed: The boulder at the bottom. The grind that grinds nothing. Sisyphus staring at the hill and refusing. Is it burnout — or wisdom?
fire.prompt: Sisyphus Pushing the Boulder as Divination Card

fire.name: Nine of Fire
fire.title: Cerberus
fire.upright: Three heads. One gate. Cerberus guards the entrance to the underworld — nothing passes without his consent. The Nine of Fire is the gatekeeper. Someone stands between you and your goal. Prove yourself worthy of passage.
fire.reversed: The gate left unguarded. The watchdog sleeping. Cerberus tamed by Orpheus's song. The gatekeeper was never the real obstacle.
fire.prompt: Cerberus Guardian of the Underworld as Divination Card

fire.name: Ten of Fire
fire.title: Phaethon
keywords: the son who couldn't hold the reins
fire.upright: Phaethon begged his father Apollo to drive the sun chariot. He couldn't hold the reins. The horses bolted. The earth burned. Zeus struck him down. The Ten of Fire is the exit — the spectacular crash that ends the story. Not all endings are graceful. Some are mythic.
fire.reversed: The crash survived. Phaethon pulled from the wreckage. The exit that could have killed you — but didn't. What did you learn about the reins?
fire.prompt: Phaethon Falling from the Sun Chariot as Divination Card

fire.name: Page of Fire
fire.title: Ganymede
fire.upright: Zeus saw Ganymede and carried him to Olympus to serve as cupbearer to the gods. The Page of Fire is the young one who watches, learns, pours the wine. You are new here. That is your power.
fire.reversed: The cupbearer who never advances. Eternal youth as eternal servitude. When do you set down the cup and take a seat?
fire.prompt: Ganymede Cupbearer of the Gods as Divination Card

fire.name: Knight of Fire
fire.title: Achilles
fire.upright: Achilles charges and the Trojans break. The Knight of Fire is conviction as armor — the warrior who cannot be stopped, driven by rage and love and the need to be remembered. Charge. But know your heel.
fire.reversed: The heel struck. The rage that consumed the warrior. Achilles sulking in his tent while the battle rages. Conviction without action is just pride.
fire.prompt: Achilles the Invincible Warrior as Divination Card

fire.name: Queen of Fire
fire.title: Penthesilea
fire.upright: Penthesilea led the Amazons to Troy. She fought Achilles himself and earned his respect — after death. The Queen of Fire is the sovereign who does not ask permission. She built the empire. She commands the field. Take your seat.
fire.reversed: The queen who fights alone. Power without allies. Penthesilea abandoned by her own. Who stands with you on the field?
fire.prompt: Penthesilea Amazon Queen as Divination Card

fire.name: King of Fire
fire.title: Minos
fire.upright: Minos built the labyrinth to contain the monster — and then became one. The King of Fire is the CEO who designed the system and now rules from within it. Absolute authority. The labyrinth is yours. Can you find your way out?
fire.reversed: The labyrinth that trapped its builder. The king who became the monster at the center. Minos judging others while his own house devours itself.
fire.prompt: King Minos Builder of the Labyrinth as Divination Card

earth.name: Ace of Earth
earth.title: Midas
earth.upright: Everything he touched turned to gold. Midas got what he wished for — and nearly starved. The Ace of Earth is the first dollar, the genesis of wealth. It is a blessing. Know what it might cost you.
earth.reversed: The curse recognized. Midas washing his hands in the river, the gold flowing away. The wealth you prayed for is killing you. Let it go.
earth.prompt: King Midas with the Golden Touch as Divination Card

earth.name: Two of Earth
earth.title: Aristaeus
earth.upright: Aristaeus kept bees. He made cheese. He tended the small things while the great gods fought their wars. The Two of Earth is the side hustle — the quiet craft that sustains when the main gig fails. Tend it.
earth.reversed: The bees dying. The side hustle that consumes the main work. Aristaeus punished for Orpheus's death — the collateral damage of the side pursuit.
earth.prompt: Aristaeus God of Beekeeping as Divination Card

earth.name: Three of Earth
earth.title: The Argonauts
earth.upright: Jason gathered the greatest heroes of the age — each with a skill, each with a flaw. The Three of Earth is the collab. The crew that makes the impossible possible. Who is on your ship?
earth.reversed: The crew that mutinies. The Argonauts scattering. The shared quest that fractured under pressure. Vet your shipmates.
earth.prompt: The Argonauts on Their Quest as Divination Card

earth.name: Four of Earth
earth.title: Tantalus
earth.upright: The fruit hangs above him. The water recedes when he bends to drink. Tantalus is surrounded by everything he wants and can touch none of it. The Four of Earth is the FinCuck — the feast you can see but not taste. Is the exclusion real, or self-imposed?
earth.reversed: The feast reached. Tantalus breaking the curse. The abundance that was always yours. What barrier did you finally push through?
earth.prompt: Tantalus Reaching for the Unreachable as Divination Card

earth.name: Five of Earth
earth.title: Demeter's Grief
earth.upright: Persephone descends and Demeter withdraws the harvest. The earth goes cold. The Five of Earth is the rent hike, the market crash, the scarcity that strikes when what you love is taken. Winter is real. But it is seasonal.
earth.reversed: The first green shoot. Persephone returning. The market recovering. Grief releasing its grip on the ground. The scarcity is ending.
earth.prompt: Demeter Grieving the Barren Earth as Divination Card

earth.name: Six of Earth
earth.title: Xenia
earth.upright: Xenia is the sacred law of hospitality — the stranger at the door may be a god in disguise. The Six of Earth is the tip jar, the mutual aid, the gift given without contract. Give. The guest may be Zeus.
earth.reversed: The door closed. Hospitality withheld. The stranger turned away. What god did you just refuse?
earth.prompt: Xenia Sacred Hospitality as Divination Card

earth.name: Seven of Earth
earth.title: Triptolemus
earth.upright: Demeter gave Triptolemus the first seed and a winged chariot to spread agriculture across the world. The Seven of Earth is the seed round — the investment that takes years to mature. Plant. Wait. The harvest is not tomorrow.
earth.reversed: The failed crop. The seed that never sprouted. The investment that withered in the field. Was it the seed, or the soil?
earth.prompt: Triptolemus Sowing the First Seed as Divination Card

earth.name: Eight of Earth
earth.title: Daedalus
earth.upright: Daedalus built the labyrinth. He built the wings. He built whatever kings asked and then built his way out. The Eight of Earth is the craft — the skill that cannot be taken from you. Make. Ship. Make again.
earth.reversed: The maker trapped by his own creation. Daedalus locked in the labyrinth he designed. Craft without purpose. Skill that serves the wrong master.
earth.prompt: Daedalus the Master Craftsman as Divination Card

earth.name: Nine of Earth
earth.title: Narcissus
earth.upright: Narcissus saw his reflection and fell in love. The Nine of Earth is the influencer — the curated self, the brand, the pool that shows only what you want to see. Self-love is power. Self-obsession is a mirror with no back.
earth.reversed: The pool broken. Narcissus looking up. The reflection losing its hold. There is a world beyond the mirror.
earth.prompt: Narcissus Gazing at His Reflection as Divination Card

earth.name: Ten of Earth
earth.title: House of Atreus
earth.upright: The House of Atreus ruled Mycenae for generations — and every generation bathed in blood. The Ten of Earth is the dynasty. The wealth that passes down. The curse that passes with it. What are you inheriting?
earth.reversed: The curse broken. The dynasty ended. Atreus's last descendant laying down the knife. Sometimes the greatest inheritance is freedom from the inheritance.
earth.prompt: The House of Atreus Cursed Dynasty as Divination Card

earth.name: Page of Earth
earth.title: Autolycus
earth.upright: Autolycus, son of Hermes, could steal anything and never be caught. The Page of Earth is the reseller — the young hustler learning the margins, flipping what others discard. Every trade is an education.
earth.reversed: The thief caught. The hustle that hustled itself. Autolycus finally outwitted. The margins weren't worth the risk.
earth.prompt: Autolycus the Master Thief as Divination Card

earth.name: Knight of Earth
earth.title: Croesus
earth.upright: Croesus, king of Lydia, so wealthy his name became a word. He believed his gold made him invincible. The Knight of Earth is the true believer in wealth — the crypto bro, the gold bug, the one who rides the market with religious conviction. Belief moves money.
earth.reversed: Croesus on the pyre. The wealth that didn't save him. The coin that couldn't stop the conqueror. Gold is heavy. It will not carry you.
earth.prompt: King Croesus the Wealthiest King as Divination Card

earth.name: Queen of Earth
earth.title: Rhea
earth.upright: Rhea saved Zeus from Kronos. She fed the stone to the father who ate his children. The Queen of Earth is the matriarch — the one who holds the household together through cunning, patience, and abundance. She feeds everyone. Who feeds her?
earth.reversed: The depleted mother. Rhea after the hiding, after the saving, with nothing left for herself. Caretaker burnout. The matriarch who needs mothering.
earth.prompt: Rhea Mother of the Gods as Divination Card

earth.name: King of Earth
earth.title: Plutus
earth.upright: Plutus, god of wealth, is blind. He distributes riches without seeing who receives them. The King of Earth is the whale — the one who moves markets without trying, who holds enough capital to shape reality. Power is not spend. It is the ability to spend.
earth.reversed: Plutus blinded by Zeus so he could no longer favor only the good. Wealth that lost its direction. The whale beached. Capital that cannot move.
earth.prompt: Plutus God of Wealth as Divination Card

water.name: Ace of Water
water.title: Eros
water.upright: Eros looses the arrow and the heart is pierced. The Ace of Water is the DM slide — the vulnerable reach, the message sent into the void, the heart opened without guarantee. Connection begins with risk.
water.reversed: The arrow missed. The message left unread. Eros blindfolded and shooting wild. The reach that found no target.
water.prompt: Eros God of Love Loosing an Arrow as Divination Card

water.name: Two of Water
water.title: Echo & Narcissus
keywords: one speaks one hears only self
water.upright: Echo could only repeat what others said. Narcissus could only hear himself. The Two of Water is the talking stage — the conversation where one voice dominates and the other only reflects. Who is speaking? Who is echoing?
water.reversed: Echo finding her own voice. Narcissus looking up from the pool. The talking stage evolving into real dialogue — or ending so both can find a better match.
water.prompt: Echo and Narcissus as Divination Card

water.name: Three of Water
water.title: The Muses
water.upright: Nine voices in harmony. The Muses sing together and the world becomes more beautiful. The Three of Water is the group chat — the circle that holds you, the friends who inspire, the community that amplifies. Find your chorus.
water.reversed: The Muses divided. The chorus that became competition. The group chat that turned toxic. Discord where there should be harmony.
water.prompt: The Nine Muses in Harmony as Divination Card

water.name: Four of Water
water.title: Eurydice
water.upright: Eurydice, bitten by the serpent, pulled back into the underworld just as Orpheus turned. The Four of Water is the ghost — the person who vanished without explanation, the silence that is itself a message. They are not coming back. The silence is the answer.
water.reversed: The ghost returning. Eurydice walking out of the dark on her own terms. The explanation offered. But trust, once vanished, is slow to return.
water.prompt: Eurydice Returning to the Underworld as Divination Card

water.name: Five of Water
water.title: Calypso
water.upright: Calypso kept Odysseus for seven years. She offered him immortality. He chose to leave. The Five of Water is the situationship — the thing that was everything to one person and a detour to the other. Grieve what the other person couldn't feel.
water.reversed: Calypso releasing Odysseus. The island left behind. The situationship ending — and the clarity that comes when you stop holding someone who wants to leave.
water.prompt: Calypso on Her Island as Divination Card

water.name: Six of Water
water.title: Orpheus
water.upright: Orpheus looked back — and lost Eurydice forever. The Six of Water is the nostalgia post, the memory that pulls you backward, the song so beautiful it stops time. Honor the past. Don't turn around.
water.reversed: Orpheus walking forward without looking back. The memory released. The song that honors what was without trying to retrieve it.
water.prompt: Orpheus Looking Back as Divination Card

water.name: Seven of Water
water.title: The Lotus-Eaters
water.upright: Odysseus's crew ate the lotus and forgot home. The Seven of Water is the daydream — the fantasy so sweet it becomes an island. Dream the alternate life. Then choose this one.
water.reversed: The lotus wearing off. Waking from the dream. The island that was paradise revealed as prison. Return to the ship.
water.prompt: The Lotus-Eaters on Their Island as Divination Card

water.name: Eight of Water
water.title: Aeneas & Dido
water.upright: Aeneas sailed from Carthage. Dido built a pyre. The Eight of Water is the leaving — the departure that wounds everyone but must happen. Duty calls. The ship is in the harbor. Go.
water.reversed: The leaving delayed. Aeneas lingering in Carthage. The departure postponed until the pyre is already lit. What are you waiting for?
water.prompt: Aeneas Sailing from Carthage as Divination Card

water.name: Nine of Water
water.title: The Sirens
water.upright: The Sirens sing and sailors crash on the rocks. The Nine of Water is the eGirl, the projected desire, the avatar of everything you want to want. The song is real. The rocks are real too. Who is singing? Who is listening?
water.reversed: The Sirens falling silent. Odysseus lashed to the mast, hearing the song and surviving it. The fantasy recognized as fantasy. The desire named and navigated.
water.prompt: The Sirens Singing from the Rocks as Divination Card

water.name: Ten of Water
water.title: Eros & Psyche
water.upright: Psyche endured the trials of Aphrodite. Eros defied his mother. They married on Olympus. The Ten of Water is the wedding — the happy ending earned through suffering, the union that almost didn't happen. This is the culmination. Live in it.
water.reversed: The wedding that wasn't. The trials that broke the lovers. Eros & Psyche separated by doubt. The arc that was almost complete. What trial did you fail?
water.prompt: Eros and Psyche United as Divination Card

water.name: Page of Water
water.title: Apollo & Daphne
water.upright: Apollo chased Daphne. She turned into a laurel tree rather than be caught. The Page of Water is the crush — the flutter, the pursuit, the young emotion that doesn't yet know if it's love or just speed. Enjoy the chase. Respect the tree.
water.reversed: The chase abandoned. Apollo wearing the laurel in mourning. The crush that taught you something about desire — and about letting go.
water.prompt: Apollo Chasing Daphne as Divination Card

water.name: Knight of Water
water.title: Paris
water.upright: Paris chose Aphrodite over Athena and Hera. He got Helen. He started the Trojan War. The Knight of Water is the romantic — the grand gesture that changes everything. Love is a choice. Know what you're trading for it.
water.reversed: Paris on the battlefield, Helen watching from the walls. The romantic who started a war and couldn't finish it. The grand gesture that cost more than the love was worth.
water.prompt: Paris Choosing Aphrodite as Divination Card

water.name: Queen of Water
water.title: The Pythia
water.upright: The Pythia sat on the tripod at Delphi and spoke the words of Apollo. She heard what others could not. The Queen of Water is the therapist, the listener, the one who holds space. Seek counsel. Be counsel.
water.reversed: The Oracle silent. The Pythia refusing the tripod. The listener who has heard too much. Even oracles need to be heard.
water.prompt: The Pythia Oracle of Delphi as Divination Card

water.name: King of Water
water.title: Chiron
water.upright: Chiron, the wisest centaur, wounded by a poisoned arrow that would never heal. He taught heroes from his wound. The King of Water is the priest — the spiritual authority who knows suffering and still serves. His wound is his credential.
water.reversed: Chiron giving up his immortality to escape the pain. The healer who could not heal himself. The priest who lost faith. Even Chiron needed release.
water.prompt: Chiron the Wounded Healer as Divination Card

air.name: Ace of Air
air.title: Iris
air.upright: Iris rides the rainbow between worlds, carrying messages the gods don't want delivered. The Ace of Air is the leak — the truth that breaks containment, the DM screenshot, the secret that changes everything. Information wants to be free.
air.reversed: The message intercepted. Iris caught between worlds. The leak that was planted, not real. Verify before you amplify.
air.prompt: Iris Rainbow Messenger as Divination Card

air.name: Two of Air
air.title: The Sphinx
air.upright: The Sphinx asked: what walks on four legs, then two, then three? The Two of Air is the subtext — the meaning hidden beneath the words, the riddle that must be solved before you can pass. Read carefully. The real message is underneath.
air.reversed: The riddle solved. Oedipus answered and the Sphinx fell. The subtext decoded. The hidden meaning revealed — and with it, the path forward.
air.prompt: The Sphinx Asking Her Riddle as Divination Card

air.name: Three of Air
air.title: The Assembly
air.upright: The Athenian Assembly gathered and every citizen spoke. The Three of Air is the groupthink — the consensus that forms, the narrative that wins. Agreement is comfortable. Is it correct?
air.reversed: The Assembly divided. The vote that failed. The consensus that cracked. One dissenting voice that changed the course. Courage is lonely.
air.prompt: The Athenian Assembly as Divination Card

air.name: Four of Air
air.title: Cassandra
air.upright: Cassandra saw the fall of Troy. She screamed the truth. No one believed her. The Four of Air is the doomscroll — the compulsion to see what's coming, the curse of knowing what others deny. You are not crazy. You are Cassandra.
air.reversed: Cassandra believed at last — too late. The doomscroll stopped. The prophecy acknowledged. The anxiety quieting. Sometimes being right is a curse. Sometimes relief comes when the disaster finally arrives and you can say: I saw this.
air.prompt: Cassandra the Unheeded Prophet as Divination Card

air.name: Five of Air
air.title: Arachne
air.upright: Arachne wove a tapestry mocking the gods — and it was perfect. Athena couldn't fault the work, so she destroyed the weaver. The Five of Air is the ratio — the public takedown, the post that was too good, the skill that threatened power. You won. That's why you were punished.
air.reversed: Arachne as a spider, still weaving. The ratio survived. The skill that outlasts the punishment. The post that got you ratio'd taught you something. Keep weaving.
air.prompt: Arachne Weaving Her Tapestry as Divination Card

air.name: Six of Air
air.title: Proteus
air.upright: Proteus changed form to avoid answering — lion, serpent, water, fire. The Six of Air is the alt account, the new identity, the fresh start. Sometimes reinvention is the only way to escape those who would hold you to your old shape.
air.reversed: Proteus caught. The shape-shifter forced to answer. The alt discovered. The mask slipping. The identity you tried to escape follows you. Integration, not escape.
air.prompt: Proteus the Shape-Shifter as Divination Card

air.name: Seven of Air
air.title: Dolos
air.upright: Dolos, spirit of trickery, could make the false seem true. The Seven of Air is the gaslight — the reality that wobbles, the manipulation that makes you doubt your own memory. Trust your senses. Dolos is a god. But so is truth.
air.reversed: Dolos exposed. The trickery recognized. The gaslight lifting. Reality firming beneath your feet. You were never crazy.
air.prompt: Dolos Spirit of Trickery as Divination Card

air.name: Eight of Air
air.title: The Erinyes
air.upright: The Erinyes pursue those who shed kindred blood. They forget nothing. Every debt is remembered. The Eight of Air is the receipts — the evidence that cannot be erased, the record that pursues. The truth is stored. Deploy it wisely.
air.reversed: The Erinyes appeased. The Furies transformed into the Kindly Ones. The receipts that were held and then released. Justice served. The record closed.
air.prompt: The Erinyes Furies of Vengeance as Divination Card

air.name: Nine of Air
air.title: Orestes
air.upright: Orestes killed his mother to avenge his father. The Erinyes pursued him without rest. The Nine of Air is the 3AM thought — the guilt that spirals, the mind that cannot find peace. The thought is not the truth. Even Orestes was eventually acquitted.
air.reversed: Orestes acquitted by Athena's court. The Furies accepting the verdict. The 3AM thought recognized as distortion. Sleep returning. You are not your worst deed.
air.prompt: Orestes Pursued by the Furies as Divination Card

air.name: Ten of Air
air.title: Ostracism
air.upright: The Athenians wrote names on pottery sherds. Whoever received the most votes was exiled for ten years. The Ten of Air is the cancellation — public judgment, exile from the discourse. The mob is loud. What is true? What is just?
air.reversed: Return from exile. The ostracized welcomed back. The cancellation expiring. The landscape has changed. Have you?
air.prompt: Ostracism The Vote to Exile as Divination Card

air.name: Page of Air
air.title: Hypnos
air.upright: Hypnos, god of sleep, watches from the shadows. He waits. He never speaks. The Page of Air is the lurker — the silent observer, learning the landscape before entering the discourse. Not every truth needs to be spoken. Yet.
air.reversed: Hypnos waking. The lurker stepping forward. The observer who finally speaks. The silence that was strategic — and now it's time.
air.prompt: Hypnos God of Sleep as Divination Card

air.name: Knight of Air
air.title: Momus
air.upright: Momus criticized the gods until they exiled him from Olympus. The Knight of Air is the shitposter — sharp, swift, dangerous with a keyboard. Wit is a weapon. Aim it. But know: even the gods can't take what they can't laugh at.
air.reversed: The post that went too far. Momus exiled, his mockery too sharp even for Olympus. The blade that cut the wielder. The shitposter who became the main character — in the worst way.
air.prompt: Momus God of Satire as Divination Card

air.name: Queen of Air
air.title: Metis
air.upright: Metis, goddess of wisdom, was swallowed by Zeus — and continued to counsel him from inside his own mind. The Queen of Air is the operative — the power behind the throne, the strategy no one sees. Not all influence is loud.
air.reversed: Metis forgotten. The operative whose wisdom is ignored. The strategy that was never implemented. The voice inside the system that no one listens to anymore.
air.prompt: Metis Goddess of Wisdom as Divination Card

air.name: King of Air
air.title: Odysseus
air.upright: Odysseus designed the Trojan Horse. He outwitted the Cyclops. He navigated the Sirens. He came home after twenty years and reclaimed his throne. The King of Air is the architect — the one who designs the system and executes the long game. Cunning is a form of patience.
air.reversed: Odysseus lost at sea. The cunning that outsmarted itself. The architect whose system became a maze with no exit. Even the wisest king needs the gods to eventually let him come home.
air.prompt: Odysseus the Cunning King as Divination Card
